how_customers_find_and_choose: Buyers discover products through short videos, creator recommendations, marketplace search and shared links in chat
Before buying, shoppers look for real photos, honest reviews, clear delivery time and a return rule they trust
Social-commerce buyers often confirm the order in chat and pay by cash on delivery or transfer
Marketplace buyers compare listings on price, reviews, delivery speed and seller rating
what_works_now: Clear, real product photos and a short video showing the item in use
Plain delivery time and return rules written on every listing and repeated at order confirmation
A saved set of replies for stock, size, delivery and payment questions
A message to the buyer when the order is confirmed, dispatched and delivered
Asking buyers for a review with a photo after delivery
Tracking returns and refused parcels by reason and by product to find what to fix
A saved list of repeat buyers told of new stock, with their consent
outdated_or_weak: Selling items you have never seen with long, uncertain delivery times
Heavy discounting that erases the margin
Advertising a product with stock photos copied from elsewhere
Growing paid ads before the basics of delivery and returns work
Ignoring complaints or deleting negative reviews

PK: Cash on delivery and cash at the counter are still common; bank transfer and mobile wallet payments are now normal for many customers

Summer heat, monsoon rain and power cuts affect operations and footfall
Customers often write in Urdu, Roman Urdu or a regional language, and chat is the usual first contact
Cash on delivery remains common and brings refused parcels and slow remittance; courier choice and speed matter
Eid, wedding season and sale days drive spikes in orders
UAE: Customers are multilingual and expect quick replies in chat; card and tap payments are normal
Winter is the busy season; many residents travel in summer so demand can dip
Ramadan and Eid change hours and buying patterns; the licence a business holds decides what it may sell and advertise, so the owner checks that with the licensing body
Fast delivery expectations and strong competition; cash on delivery is still used for many orders
A trade licence and the correct activity for online selling are touchpoints; the owner confirms specifics with the authority

Long winters and a short summer peak shape outdoor and seasonal trades
English and French (in Quebec) matter, and many communities prefer their own language; consent for marketing messages and sales tax rules vary, so the owner checks them with a professional
Shoppers expect free or clear shipping, easy returns and fast support; delivery time and distance matter
Sales tax collection and consumer rules for online selling vary; the owner confirms specifics with a professional

never_assume: A registered brand or storefront of their own
